name: Sunteck Realty Ltd
tagline: Mumbai-MMR developer on an asset-light JDA model with pre-sales compounding ~30% and net-debt-free — cheaper than MMR peers, but chronic ~5-6% ROCE, collections that lag pre-sales for years, and ~Rs 18k Cr of the GDV in doubt (Kalyan + Dubai)
business_overview: MMR-focused residential developer (Bandra-to-Virar western suburbs) doing large-format, township-style projects mostly via joint development agreements (little upfront land cash). Building a small commercial rental portfolio at BKC/ODC. Total GDV ~Rs 40,000-42,000 Cr; ~50 mn sq ft balance pipeline; one Dubai Downtown project.
fundamentals_table: ~Rs 3,315 Cr (+31% YoY); guidance was ~Rs 3,000 Cr — met
~Rs 1,255 Cr FY26 (grew ~24% in Q2 FY26 after years of lag)
~Rs 990 Cr; OPM ~28%; Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin ~35%
FY21 Rs 1,022 Cr -> FY26 Rs 3,315 Cr (~26% CAGR); collections roughly flat FY23-FY25
fundamentals_narrative: Pre-sales have compounded ~26% for five years, the balance sheet is net-debt-free, and the stock trades cheaper than Lodha/Oberoi/Godrej Properties on most measures. But reported returns are chronically low (3-yr ROE ~4.4%, ROCE ~6%) because collections have lagged pre-sales since FY24 — a multi-year working-capital drag that the market has refused to 'trust' despite 6+ quarters of PAT growth. On top of that, an elevated user estimates ~Rs 18,000 Cr of the ~Rs 42,000 Cr GDV is in doubt: the Kalyan project (weak location, no infra push, hard to sell) and the Dubai project (launch on hold on Middle-East geopolitics). Management guides pre-sales +25-35% and GDV to double every ~3 years.
sentiment_summary: Actively followed; elevated user Vineetjain111 tracks it and expects the P&L to keep improving as projects complete; another elevated user (vikasbargale) took an initial position in Jan 2025. But the recurring debate is why the stock lags peers — low ROCE, collections lag, and the GDV-quality question. Mohnish Pabrai fully exited in 2024 (stated reason: leaving India, not a Sunteck-specific view).
community_signal: No high-conviction trusted 'buy' call; a short bull thesis (gnarasg, Oct 2024, well-received) and tracking positions from a couple of elevated users. Discovery candidate, theme-rank 2 (no live-theme keyword match).
key_new_facts: FY26 pre-sales ~Rs 3,315 Cr (+31%), meeting the ~Rs 3,000 Cr guide; collections growth finally picked up (~24% in Q2 FY26).
Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin ~35%; management reiterates pre-sales +25-35% for FY27 and GDV doubling every ~3 years.
Elevated-user view (Jul 2026): ~Rs 18,000 Cr of ~Rs 42,000 Cr GDV in doubt — Kalyan (poor location) + Dubai (on hold, geopolitics).
Chronic low returns: 3-yr ROE ~4.4%, ROCE ~6%; collections lagged pre-sales FY23-FY25.
Mohnish Pabrai exited fully in 2024 (India-exit, not stock-specific).
bull_case: Pre-sales compounding ~26%/yr; net-debt-free; asset-light JDA model limits capital at risk
Trades at a discount to MMR peers; large ~50 mn sq ft launch pipeline
Collections finally catching up; Pabrai overhang cleared
bear_case: Chronic ~5-6% ROCE / ~4% ROE — weak value creation despite pre-sales growth
Collections lagged pre-sales for years (working-capital drag); market won't re-rate until it sticks
~Rs 18k Cr of GDV in question (Kalyan location, Dubai on hold)
Real estate is cyclical, not a structural tailwind; no 10x/100x maths from here
verdict_headline: Cheap, net-debt-free MMR developer with compounding pre-sales but structurally low returns and GDV-quality doubts — 'neither', Low-Medium conviction
verdict_reasoning: Discovery candidate, theme-rank 2 (no live-theme keyword match — recency discovery).

four_box score 2.5 (tailwind weak — MMR residential up-cycle is cyclical, not structural; tam weak — ~Rs 4,400 Cr mcap, ~Rs 42k Cr GDV but ~Rs 18k Cr in doubt and chronic low ROCE caps value creation; moat weak — western-suburbs brand + asset-light JDA model; valuation yes — clear discount to MMR peers, net-debt-free, near 52w low). Valuation box is 'yes', so a return-magnitude label is technically permitted (exception) — but the honest return maths for a ~5-6% ROCE cyclical developer is ~2-3x on a cycle turn + re-rating, nowhere near 10x-in-2-3-years or 100x-in-10-years, so thesis_fit stays 'neither'.
No red flag; real-estate revenue-recognition lumpiness explains the low reported ROE but the through-cycle return profile is genuinely modest.

Conviction Low-Medium: a credible, cheap cyclical turnaround with a clean balance sheet, held back by low returns, the collections lag and GDV-quality questions; a couple of elevated users hold tracking positions but there is no high-conviction trusted call. First-time read.

value_chain.theme: Mumbai / MMR residential real estate up-cycle
value_chain.position: MMR western-suburbs developer, large-format township projects, mostly JDA / asset-light
value_chain.bottleneck_node: approvals + saleable-inventory launch cadence in prime MMR micro-markets
value_chain.note: Listed MMR developers are all launching aggressively into the up-cycle (supply 'adding' = later-cycle glut risk); Sunteck's edge is a low-capital JDA model and a discounted valuation, not a pricing-power moat.

four_box.note: tailwind weak (cyclical MMR up-cycle); tam weak (low ROCE + ~Rs 18k Cr GDV in doubt cap value creation); moat weak (western-suburbs brand + JDA model); valuation yes (discount to MMR peers, net-debt-free, near 52w low). Score 2.5, valuation exception available but return magnitude is ~2-3x not 10x -> 'neither'.
